```{r}
# ============================================================
# HPAP Islet scRNA | 3-group (ND/AAB+/T1D) Pseudobulk DEG (DESeq2)
# - Per cell type (Cell Type Grouped)
# - Keep only libraries with >=30 cells in that cell type AND group in {ND,AAB+,T1D}
# - Plots: UMAP, retention curve, volcano (T1D vs ND) per cell type
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(Matrix)
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readr)
  library(DESeq2)
  library(ggrepel)
})

set.seed(1234)

in_rds  <- "/Users/jyotirmoyroy/Desktop/Immunometabolism T1D Paper/SingleCellRNASeq/MAI_T1D/hpap_islet_scRNAseq.rds"
out_dir <- "pseudobulk_deseq2_ND_AABpos_T1D"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -------------------------
# Load + config
# -------------------------
obj <- readRDS(in_rds)
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

celltype_col <- "Cell Type Grouped"
group_col    <- "Diabetes Status"
sample_col   <- "Library"  # your replicate key
min_cells    <- 30

stopifnot(celltype_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data),
          group_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data),
          sample_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))

# Keep 3 groups only
obj$group3 <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[group_col]])
obj$group3[!(obj$group3 %in% c("ND","AAB+","T1D"))] <- NA_character_
```

```{r}
if ("umap" %in% names(obj@reductions)) {
  p_umap <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap", group.by = celltype_col, label = TRUE) + NoLegend() +
    ggtitle("UMAP colored by Cell Type Grouped")
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "UMAP_celltype.png"), p_umap, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 200)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 2) Retention curve across ALL cell types (min_cells per group per Library)
# -------------------------
md <- obj@meta.data %>%
  transmute(
    cell = rownames(obj@meta.data),
    celltype = as.character(.data[[celltype_col]]),
    group3   = obj$group3,
    sample   = as.character(.data[[sample_col]])
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(group3), !is.na(celltype), celltype != "", !is.na(sample), sample != "")

# cells per (celltype, group, sample)
ct_g_s <- dplyr::count(md, celltype, group3, sample, name = "n_cells")

# for each celltype, count how many samples in each group pass threshold
ct_ret <- ct_g_s %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pass = n_cells >= min_cells) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(celltype, group3) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_samples_pass = sum(pass), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = group3, values_from = n_samples_pass, values_fill = 0) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    min_samples_pass = pmin(ND, `AAB+`, T1D),
    keep_celltype = min_samples_pass > 0
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(keep_celltype), dplyr::desc(min_samples_pass))


write_csv(ct_ret, file.path(out_dir, "retention_by_celltype_min30cells.csv"))

# retention curve vs thresholds (optional but useful)
thresholds <- c(10, 20, 30, 50, 80, 100)
ret_curve <- bind_rows(lapply(thresholds, function(K) {
  ct_g_s %>%
    dplyr::mutate(pass = n_cells >= K) %>%
   dplyr:: group_by(celltype, group3) %>%
   dplyr:: summarise(n_samples_pass = sum(pass), .groups="drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from=group3, values_from=n_samples_pass, values_fill=0) %>%
    mutate(keep = (ND>0 & `AAB+`>0 & T1D>0)) %>%
    summarise(
      cutoff = K,
      n_celltypes_kept = sum(keep),
      .groups="drop"
    )
}))
write_csv(ret_curve, file.path(out_dir, "retention_curve_by_cutoff.csv"))

p_ret <- ggplot(ret_curve, aes(x = cutoff, y = n_celltypes_kept)) +
  geom_line() + geom_point() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = thresholds) +
  labs(title = "Cell-type retention curve (require >=K cells per group per sample)",
       x = "K (min cells per sample per group)", y = "# cell types kept")
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "retention_curve.png"), p_ret, width = 7, height = 4.5, dpi = 200)

# cell types to run (must have >=1 passing sample in each group at K=30)
celltypes_run <- ct_ret %>% filter(ND > 0, `AAB+` > 0, T1D > 0) %>% pull(celltype)
message("Cell types passing min_cells=30 in ALL 3 groups: ", length(celltypes_run))


p_ret
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 3) Pseudobulk builder (per cell type)
# -------------------------
# ---- Seurat v4/v5 compatible getter ----
GetCounts <- function(seu, assay = NULL, layer = "counts") {
  if (is.null(assay)) assay <- DefaultAssay(seu)

  out <- tryCatch(
    GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, layer = layer),  # SeuratObject v5
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (is.null(out)) {
    out <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, slot = layer)  # Seurat v4 fallback
  }
  out
}

make_pseudobulk <- function(obj, celltype_value) {
  md0 <- obj@meta.data

  keep_cells <- rownames(md0)[
    obj$group3 %in% c("ND","AAB+","T1D") &
      md0[[celltype_col]] == celltype_value &
      !is.na(md0[[sample_col]]) & md0[[sample_col]] != ""
  ]
  if (length(keep_cells) == 0) return(NULL)

  sub <- subset(obj, cells = keep_cells)

  # per-sample cell counts within this cell type
  sub_md <- sub@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      sample = as.character(.data[[sample_col]]),
      group3 = as.character(sub$group3)
    )

  cs <- dplyr::count(sub_md, group3, sample, name = "n_cells") %>%
    dplyr::filter(n_cells >= min_cells)

  # require each group has >=1 passing sample
  if (!all(c("ND","AAB+","T1D") %in% cs$group3)) return(NULL)

  keep_samples <- unique(cs$sample)
  keep_cells2 <- rownames(sub@meta.data)[sub@meta.data[[sample_col]] %in% keep_samples]
  sub2 <- subset(sub, cells = keep_cells2)

  # build sample_id (unique)
  sub2$sample_id <- paste0(as.character(sub2@meta.data[[sample_col]]), "__", as.character(sub2$group3))

  # counts: ALWAYS via wrapper (layer in v5, slot in v4)
  counts <- GetCounts(sub2, layer = "counts")
  # ensure sparse
  if (!inherits(counts, "dgCMatrix")) counts <- Matrix::Matrix(counts, sparse = TRUE)

  # ---- Efficient aggregation: pb = counts %*% S ----
  g <- factor(sub2$sample_id)  # one level per pseudobulk column
  S <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~ 0 + g)  # cells x sample_id
  pb <- counts %*% S                          # genes x sample_id
  colnames(pb) <- sub("^g", "", colnames(pb)) # clean colnames from "g<level>"

  coldata <- tibble::tibble(sample_id = colnames(pb)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      group3 = stringr::str_replace(sample_id, "^.*__", ""),
      lib    = stringr::str_replace(sample_id, "__.*$", "")
    ) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(coldata) <- coldata$sample_id

  # return pb as *matrix-like*; DESeq2 accepts matrix or dgCMatrix counts
  list(pb = pb, coldata = coldata, cell_counts = cs)
}

# -------------------------
# 4) DESeq2 per cell type + volcano (T1D vs ND)
# -------------------------
deg_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "DEG_by_celltype")
dir.create(deg_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

summary_list <- list()

for (ct in celltypes_run) {
  message("Running pseudobulk DE for: ", ct)
  pb_obj <- make_pseudobulk(obj, ct)
  if (is.null(pb_obj)) next

  pb <- pb_obj$pb
  coldata <- pb_obj$coldata

  # DESeq2: 3-group model
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(pb), colData = coldata, design = ~ group3)
  dds$group3 <- factor(dds$group3, levels = c("ND","AAB+","T1D"))

  # standard minimal gene filter (keeps runtime stable)
  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  dds <- dds[keep_genes,]

  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)

  # Pairwise contrasts
  res_T1D_vs_ND  <- results(dds, contrast = c("group3", "T1D", "ND"))
  res_AAB_vs_ND  <- results(dds, contrast = c("group3", "AAB+", "ND"))
  res_T1D_vs_AAB <- results(dds, contrast = c("group3", "T1D", "AAB+"))

  # Save results
  out_base <- file.path(deg_dir, paste0("DESeq2__", make.names(ct)))
  write_csv(as.data.frame(res_T1D_vs_ND)  %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
            paste0(out_base, "__T1D_vs_ND.csv"))
  write_csv(as.data.frame(res_AAB_vs_ND)  %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
            paste0(out_base, "__AAB_vs_ND.csv"))
  write_csv(as.data.frame(res_T1D_vs_AAB) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
            paste0(out_base, "__T1D_vs_AAB.csv"))

  # Volcano: T1D vs ND
  volc <- as.data.frame(res_T1D_vs_ND) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
      sig = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0.25 ~ "Up in T1D",
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -0.25 ~ "Down in T1D",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )

  top_lab <- volc %>%
    filter(sig != "NS") %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(12)

  p_volc <- ggplot(volc, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglog10padj)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_lab, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = 50, size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0(ct, " | Volcano: T1D vs ND"),
         x = "log2FC (T1D/ND)", y = "-log10(padj)")
  ggsave(paste0(out_base, "__volcano_T1D_vs_ND.png"), p_volc, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 200)

  # Summarize samples retained
  cs <- pb_obj$cell_counts
  summ <- cs %>%
    group_by(group3) %>%
    summarise(n_samples = n(), median_cells = median(n_cells), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(celltype = ct)
  summary_list[[ct]] <- summ
}

deg_summary <- bind_rows(summary_list)
write_csv(deg_summary, file.path(out_dir, "sample_retention_summary_by_celltype.csv"))

message("Done. Outputs in: ", out_dir)
```

```{r}
# -------------------------
# 5) GSEA (fgsea) on Hallmark + WikiPathways
# - Use DESeq2 Wald statistic as rank ("pseudo rank")
# - Run for all cell types and all 3 contrasts
# - Use padj < 0.1 as significance cutoff
# - Save under:
#   .../pseudobulk_deseq2_ND_AABpos_T1D/GSEA_hallmark
#   .../pseudobulk_deseq2_ND_AABpos_T1D/GSEA_wikipathway
# -------------------------

# Fixes:
# 1) msigdbr >=10: use collection/subcollection (no deprecated category/subcategory)
# 2) fgsea tie warning: jitter ranks a tiny bit (deterministic) to break ties
# 3) ggplot error: don't map continuous padj to shape. Use color (continuous) or
#    use shape as a binned variable. Below uses color = -log10(padj) + size.

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(tibble)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

padj_cutoff <- 0.1

gsea_h_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "GSEA_hallmark")
gsea_wp_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "GSEA_wikipathway")
dir.create(gsea_h_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(gsea_wp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -------------------------
# Gene sets (msigdbr >= 10.0.0 API)
# -------------------------
msig_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "")
pathways_h <- split(msig_h$gene_symbol, msig_h$gs_name)

msig_wp <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:WIKIPATHWAYS") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "")
pathways_wp <- split(msig_wp$gene_symbol, msig_wp$gs_name)

# -------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------
make_rank <- function(res, jitter_ties = TRUE, jitter_seed = 1234, jitter_sd = 1e-08) {
  r <- res$stat
  names(r) <- rownames(res)
  r <- r[is.finite(r) & !is.na(r)]
  r <- sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)

  # break ties deterministically (fgsea warning is usually harmless, but this silences it)
  if (jitter_ties && any(duplicated(r))) {
    set.seed(jitter_seed)
    r <- r + rnorm(length(r), mean = 0, sd = jitter_sd)
    r <- sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)
  }
  r
}

run_fgsea <- function(pathways, ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500) {
  fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = pathways,
    stats    = ranks,
    minSize  = minSize,
    maxSize  = maxSize,
    eps      = 1e-50
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))
}

save_gsea_bundle <- function(fg, out_prefix, padj_cutoff = 0.1) {
  # full
  write_csv(
    fg %>% tibble::as_tibble(),
    paste0(out_prefix, "__fgsea_full.csv")
  )

  # sig
  fg_sig <- fg %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))

  write_csv(
    fg_sig %>% tibble::as_tibble(),
    paste0(out_prefix, "__fgsea_padj_lt_", padj_cutoff, ".csv")
  )

  # dotplot: top 20 by padj then |NES|
  if (nrow(fg) > 0) {
    topn <- fg %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES))) %>%
      head(20) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        pathway = factor(pathway, levels = rev(unique(pathway))),
        mlog10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300))
      )

    if (nrow(topn) > 0) {
      p <- ggplot(topn, aes(x = NES, y = pathway)) +
        geom_point(aes(size = size, color = mlog10padj), alpha = 0.9) +
        labs(
          x = "NES",
          y = NULL,
          title = basename(out_prefix),
          color = "-log10(padj)",
          size = "Set size"
        ) +
        theme_bw(base_size = 11)

      ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, "__top20_dotplot.png"), p, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200)
    }
  }

  invisible(fg_sig)
}

# -------------------------
# 6) Loop over cell types: run DESeq2 (already done above) + GSEA
#     -> Insert the block below inside your for(ct in celltypes_run) loop,
#        right AFTER you compute res_T1D_vs_ND, res_AAB_vs_ND, res_T1D_vs_AAB.
# -------------------------

# Example insertion point (inside your existing loop after res_* are computed):

# ---- GSEA per contrast (Hallmark + WikiPathways) ----
contrasts <- list(
  T1D_vs_ND  = res_T1D_vs_ND,
  AAB_vs_ND  = res_AAB_vs_ND,
  T1D_vs_AAB = res_T1D_vs_AAB
)

ct_tag <- make.names(ct)

for (cn in names(contrasts)) {
  res <- contrasts[[cn]]

  # pseudo-rank from DESeq2 stat
  ranks <- make_rank(res)
  if (length(ranks) < 50) {
    message("  [GSEA skip] ", ct, " ", cn, " : too few ranked genes (", length(ranks), ")")
    next
  }

  # ---- Hallmark ----
  fg_h <- run_fgsea(pathways_h, ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)
  out_prefix_h <- file.path(gsea_h_dir, paste0("GSEA__", ct_tag, "__", cn))
  save_gsea_bundle(fg_h, out_prefix_h, padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff)

  # ---- WikiPathways ----
  fg_wp <- run_fgsea(pathways_wp, ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)
  out_prefix_wp <- file.path(gsea_wp_dir, paste0("GSEA__", ct_tag, "__", cn))
  save_gsea_bundle(fg_wp, out_prefix_wp, padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff)
}

# -------------------------
# (Optional) write a short per-celltype summary of how many pathways pass padj<0.1
# -------------------------
# You can run this after the whole pipeline is done:
summarize_gsea_counts <- function(dir_path) {
  files <- list.files(dir_path, pattern = "__fgsea_full\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(tibble())
  bind_rows(lapply(files, function(f) {
    df <- suppressMessages(readr::read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE))
    tibble(
      file = basename(f),
      n_pathways = nrow(df),
      n_padj_lt_0.1 = sum(!is.na(df$padj) & df$padj < 0.1)
    )
  }))
}

gsea_h_counts  <- summarize_gsea_counts(gsea_h_dir)
gsea_wp_counts <- summarize_gsea_counts(gsea_wp_dir)
write_csv(gsea_h_counts,  file.path(out_dir, "GSEA_hallmark__counts_summary.csv"))
write_csv(gsea_wp_counts, file.path(out_dir, "GSEA_wikipathway__counts_summary.csv"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# FIX: Robustly run GSEA for *all* filtered cell types
# Problem in your notebook:
# - The GSEA block references `ct` but it is OUTSIDE the for(ct in celltypes_run) loop,
#   so it only runs once (or errors / uses stale `ct` from last scope).
# - Also, you recompute DESeq2 inside the loop but don’t persist res objects in a way
#   that a later, separate GSEA loop can reliably consume.
#
# Solution:
# A) Put GSEA directly INSIDE the DE loop (simplest, no extra memory).
# B) Or save DESeq2 results objects (as RDS/CSV) and run a separate GSEA loop reading them.
#
# Below implements A) and is drop-in: replace your "for (ct in celltypes_run) { ... }"
# with this improved version. It also adds tryCatch per-contrast so one failure
# doesn’t stop the entire celltype loop.
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)
  library(tibble)
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(stringr)
})

padj_cutoff <- 0.1

gsea_h_dir  <- file.path(out_dir, "GSEA_hallmark")
gsea_wp_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "GSEA_wikipathway")
dir.create(gsea_h_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(gsea_wp_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# -------------------------
# Gene sets (msigdbr >= 10 API)
# -------------------------
msig_h <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "")
pathways_h <- split(msig_h$gene_symbol, msig_h$gs_name)

msig_wp <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C2", subcollection = "CP:WIKIPATHWAYS") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, gene_symbol) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "")
pathways_wp <- split(msig_wp$gene_symbol, msig_wp$gs_name)

# -------------------------
# Helpers
# -------------------------
make_rank <- function(res, jitter_ties = TRUE, jitter_seed = 1234, jitter_sd = 1e-8) {
  # res can be DESeqResults or data.frame with column "stat" and rownames=genes
  r <- res$stat
  names(r) <- rownames(res)
  r <- r[is.finite(r) & !is.na(r)]
  r <- sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)

  if (jitter_ties && any(duplicated(r))) {
    set.seed(jitter_seed)
    r <- r + rnorm(length(r), mean = 0, sd = jitter_sd)
    r <- sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)
  }
  r
}

run_fgsea <- function(pathways, ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500) {
  fgsea::fgseaMultilevel(
    pathways = pathways,
    stats    = ranks,
    minSize  = minSize,
    maxSize  = maxSize,
    eps      = 1e-50
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))
}

save_gsea_bundle <- function(fg, out_prefix, padj_cutoff = 0.1) {
  write_csv(as_tibble(fg), paste0(out_prefix, "__fgsea_full.csv"))

  fg_sig <- fg %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj) & padj < padj_cutoff) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES)))

  write_csv(as_tibble(fg_sig), paste0(out_prefix, "__fgsea_padj_lt_", padj_cutoff, ".csv"))

  # dotplot: top 20
  topn <- fg %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(padj, dplyr::desc(abs(NES))) %>%
    head(20) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pathway = factor(pathway, levels = rev(unique(pathway))),
      mlog10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300))
    )

  if (nrow(topn) > 0) {
    p <- ggplot(topn, aes(x = NES, y = pathway)) +
      geom_point(aes(size = size, color = mlog10padj), alpha = 0.9) +
      labs(
        x = "NES", y = NULL,
        title = basename(out_prefix),
        color = "-log10(padj)",
        size = "Set size"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 11)
    ggsave(paste0(out_prefix, "__top20_dotplot.png"), p, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 200)
  }

  invisible(fg_sig)
}

# -------------------------
# Improved DE + GSEA loop
# - runs GSEA for every ct that passes filtering
# - per-contrast tryCatch so one bad contrast doesn’t kill the loop
# - writes a compact per-ct GSEA count summary
# -------------------------
deg_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "DEG_by_celltype")
dir.create(deg_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

summary_list <- list()
gsea_counts  <- list()

for (ct in celltypes_run) {
  message("====================================================")
  message("Running pseudobulk DE + GSEA for: ", ct)

  pb_obj <- make_pseudobulk(obj, ct)
  if (is.null(pb_obj)) {
    message("  [skip] make_pseudobulk returned NULL")
    next
  }

  pb <- pb_obj$pb
  coldata <- pb_obj$coldata

  # DESeq2
  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = round(pb), colData = coldata, design = ~ group3)
  dds$group3 <- factor(dds$group3, levels = c("ND","AAB+","T1D"))

  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts(dds) >= 10) >= 2
  dds <- dds[keep_genes,]

  if (nrow(dds) < 200) {
    message("  [skip] too few genes after filtering: ", nrow(dds))
    next
  }

  dds <- DESeq(dds, quiet = TRUE)

  res_T1D_vs_ND  <- results(dds, contrast = c("group3", "T1D", "ND"))
  res_AAB_vs_ND  <- results(dds, contrast = c("group3", "AAB+", "ND"))
  res_T1D_vs_AAB <- results(dds, contrast = c("group3", "T1D", "AAB+"))

  ct_tag <- make.names(ct)
  out_base <- file.path(deg_dir, paste0("DESeq2__", ct_tag))

  # Save DE results
  write_csv(as.data.frame(res_T1D_vs_ND)  %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
            paste0(out_base, "__T1D_vs_ND.csv"))
  write_csv(as.data.frame(res_AAB_vs_ND)  %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
            paste0(out_base, "__AAB_vs_ND.csv"))
  write_csv(as.data.frame(res_T1D_vs_AAB) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("gene"),
            paste0(out_base, "__T1D_vs_AAB.csv"))

  # Volcano (unchanged)
  volc <- as.data.frame(res_T1D_vs_ND) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    mutate(
      neglog10padj = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-300)),
      sig = case_when(
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > 0.25 ~ "Up in T1D",
        !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -0.25 ~ "Down in T1D",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )

  top_lab <- volc %>%
    filter(sig != "NS") %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    head(12)

  p_volc <- ggplot(volc, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = neglog10padj)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.25, 0.25), linetype = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = 2) +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_lab, aes(label = gene), max.overlaps = 50, size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0(ct, " | Volcano: T1D vs ND"),
         x = "log2FC (T1D/ND)", y = "-log10(padj)")
  ggsave(paste0(out_base, "__volcano_T1D_vs_ND.png"), p_volc, width = 6.5, height = 5, dpi = 200)

  # Sample retention summary (unchanged)
  cs <- pb_obj$cell_counts
  summ <- cs %>%
    group_by(group3) %>%
    summarise(n_samples = n(), median_cells = median(n_cells), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(celltype = ct)
  summary_list[[ct]] <- summ

  # -------------------------
  # GSEA (NOW ACTUALLY LOOPED PER CELL TYPE)
  # -------------------------
  contrasts <- list(
    T1D_vs_ND  = res_T1D_vs_ND,
    AAB_vs_ND  = res_AAB_vs_ND,
    T1D_vs_AAB = res_T1D_vs_AAB
  )

  for (cn in names(contrasts)) {
    message("  GSEA: ", cn)

    ok <- tryCatch({
      res <- contrasts[[cn]]
      ranks <- make_rank(res)

      if (length(ranks) < 200) {
        message("    [GSEA skip] too few ranked genes: ", length(ranks))
        return(FALSE)
      }

      # Hallmark
      fg_h <- run_fgsea(pathways_h, ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)
      out_prefix_h <- file.path(gsea_h_dir, paste0("GSEA__", ct_tag, "__", cn))
      save_gsea_bundle(fg_h, out_prefix_h, padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff)

      # WikiPathways
      fg_wp <- run_fgsea(pathways_wp, ranks, minSize = 15, maxSize = 500)
      out_prefix_wp <- file.path(gsea_wp_dir, paste0("GSEA__", ct_tag, "__", cn))
      save_gsea_bundle(fg_wp, out_prefix_wp, padj_cutoff = padj_cutoff)

      # counts for summary
      gsea_counts[[paste(ct_tag, cn, "H", sep="__")]] <- tibble(
        celltype = ct, contrast = cn, collection = "Hallmark",
        n_pathways = nrow(fg_h),
        n_padj_lt = sum(!is.na(fg_h$padj) & fg_h$padj < padj_cutoff)
      )
      gsea_counts[[paste(ct_tag, cn, "WP", sep="__")]] <- tibble(
        celltype = ct, contrast = cn, collection = "WikiPathways",
        n_pathways = nrow(fg_wp),
        n_padj_lt = sum(!is.na(fg_wp$padj) & fg_wp$padj < padj_cutoff)
      )

      TRUE
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("    [GSEA ERROR] ", ct, " ", cn, " : ", conditionMessage(e))
      FALSE
    })

    if (!ok) next
  }
}

deg_summary <- bind_rows(summary_list)
write_csv(deg_summary, file.path(out_dir, "sample_retention_summary_by_celltype.csv"))

gsea_summary <- bind_rows(gsea_counts)
write_csv(gsea_summary, file.path(out_dir, paste0("GSEA__counts_summary_padj_lt_", padj_cutoff, ".csv")))

message("Done. Outputs in: ", out_dir)
```
